verdicts.reason: A keeps the FIZZBANG! pill and the SINCE 2026 badge together as one unit, as in the original. But the group sits well below centre, leaving the top ~45% as empty halftone, and the badge is enlarged to about 73% of the pill's width, which weakens the hierarchy. B pulls the badge away from the logo and pins it to the bottom edge, which breaks the grouping and leaves a dead band between them. It also blows the badge up to almost the pill's full width, so it competes with the brand mark as a second focal point.
